text_block_list.text:
One evening.
While organizing documents in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you have some time after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I told you at the end of the summer camp, didn't I?
About 'what I want to do.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "A challenge." ...I'm going to deliver it, so come with me.

Led by Mejiro Dober, I walk through the academy grounds.
Where we arrived was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're here already?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a bit earlier than our scheduled time,
but I wanted to watch the sunset for a bit—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Dober.
Let's hear your business."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much... for everything up until today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai has guided me so, so much up until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I had just entered the academy...
and I was feeling confused by male instructors...
you oversaw my training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I was rushing myself, troubled by how
different I was from McQueen and Ryan...
You showed me the ideal I should aim for—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Watching over my debut race... and giving me courage when I was terrified before the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Rebuking me whenever I wavered and was about to give in to my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai.
I—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ――I will become "Mejiro Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Without longing for anyone else, without comparing myself to anything.
I will become the one and only radiance in this world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Will you... accept this?

With that, Mejiro Dober
offered a single flower to Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'll gladly accept it.

Air Groove smiled, and the flowers
Mejiro Dober offered—
I received a yellow carnation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In the language of flowers, yellow carnations mean 'jealousy'.
Usually, it's a meaning people avoid, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Among us Umamusume, there are those who intentionally choose to give it as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At times, to her mother—a great predecessor—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To the senior I looked up to—

text_block_list.name: Dober & Groove
text_block_list.text: —Filled with the resolve to "surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...So you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Everything you've taught me, Senpai...
I remember every single bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Because you are my inspiration.
My ideal. And—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because she's the Umamusume I want to surpass the most...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I will surpass you, Senpai...
and carve out my own path to truly becoming "Mejiro Dober"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I like that spirit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
I'll be waiting for you there, Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You carry a fine staff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad you accepted it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
For being there to see it through with me.
choice_data_list: Why did you let me be present for this?
Why did you let me be there with you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What do you mean why?... It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer is someone
who has guided me so much, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Declaring my own future in front of Senpai
and Trainer. That's... what I wanted
to do today."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai knew that too,
which is why she looked at Trainer and didn't say a word."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what's that? What're you thanking me for?
How weird—

Her smile, illuminated by the evening sky,
is something I will surely never forget...

The Fuchu Umamusume Stakes, the prelude to
the upcoming Queen Elizabeth II Cup, is right around the corner...!
